figma.description: Figma design files via Framelink's figma-developer-mcp (third-party server). get_figma_data returns a file's name, pages, frames (with node ids), and components so you can see what design work exists and how it's named.

contentful.description: Infisical's website content in Contentful (Contentful's remote MCP server; Agent Vault signs it in with OAuth). Pass spaceId and environmentId ("master" unless told otherwise) on every call. Read entries, content types, and assets in any session. In a write session you can create and update DRAFT entries and assets; you can never publish, unpublish, or delete. A human publishes in Contentful.
